subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The box at the entrance was not just storage.”?
options: Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and speak.
It tells a community where it stands in relation to danger, travel, and home.
Being seen online is not the same as being understood in person.
It was a test of community behavior in the age of online shopping.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every age has tools that change who can read, learn, and speak.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It tells a community where it stands in relation to danger, travel, and home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Being seen online is not the same as being understood in person.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The box at the entrance was not just storage. It was a test of community behavior in the age of online shopping.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The box at the entrance was not just storage. It was a test of community behavior in the age of online shopping.」，答案為「It was a test of community behavior in the age of online shopping.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It was a test of community behavior in the age of online shopping.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
